exact_finite.statement: RFGH is Q-F exact on complete 4x4-k4 and on complete 3x3-k3, 3x4-k3, 4x3-k3 and 4x4-k3 controls.
On complete 4x4-k4, RFGH has 29,986 direct classes; its S4 transporter orbit has 9,286 classes and is Q-F/Q-A/Q-V exact.
The 9,286-class q_SigmaRFGH carrier is the smallest transporter-aware Q-F representation tested so far on complete 4x4-k4, superseding q_SigmaRFG at 9,308.
H commutes with R/F/G and is idempotent on complete 4x4-k4.
Across all five complete decomposition cases, each residual deleted by R, G or H is also deleted by E1.
E1 and RGH are not generally equal as normalized representations and are not generally the same partition.
Across all five complete cases, F(E1(q)) and RFGH(q) induce exactly the same partition of physical states, with zero partition mismatches, although their residual keys can differ.

deductive_candidate: H is rank-local: it uses only current support, residual ownership/cells and persistent geometry.
When one column is nonfull, owner of its future row r is ((W-1)*H+r) mod 2; this is invariant under column relabeling because row and board dimensions are preserved.
Therefore H is column-permutation covariant as an abstract support/residual rule.
If the existing general q_Sigma, R, F and G candidate laws qualify, H composes with them without requiring an additional transported scalar coordinate.

quotient_interpretation.strongest_tested: F∘E1 and RFGH are lossless recodings of one state partition on all five complete tested domains.
not_claimed: their residual normal forms are identical
